_readme: DATA-01 / REV-01 / REV-02 / REV-04 / V1-001 residuals: one synthetic table read by BOTH app/test/engine/parser/declined_state_cues_table_test.dart and process-ios-sms/parse_test.ts. expect: not_completed = the message reports no completed money movement (never confirmed money in either direction and no total changes; the on-device capture lands in Smart Inbox review, the server rejects it); completed_payment = a completed purchase that must keep parsing as spending; completed_credit = a genuine refund/reversal that must keep parsing as a refund (device type refund; server direction credit, type refund). src V1-RES = the residuals the release owner reopened. src V1-RES2 = the fourth round: a reversed purchase (ambiguous: the original may or may not have been recorded) and a status header ('Declined transactions: 1. …') are not_completed, i.e. review with no total change; 'Your card expired on …' and 'approved. Previous attempt declined.' next to a purchase are kept in review on purpose (not decidable by the clause rule); a cue followed by 'use' ('For unauthorized use call …') is advice. src V1-RES3 = the final independent review (K, FR-01/02/03/13): pending, held, blocked, failed cash/transfer/bill payments, future statuses naming an amount, a status after a report header or before a question clause, and a refund or reversal that names a declined original or a debit ('Reversal of declined purchase … credited', 'POS reversal', 'تم خصم … وتم استرجاعه') are not_completed (the original was never recorded, or the message nets to nothing); the six earlier completed_credit refunds of a declined/failed original moved to not_completed by the same owner policy; 'POS purchase … FAILED VENTURES', 'at Café Cancelled' and 'Partial reversal … for purchase' stay in review on purpose (not decidable). Two further outcomes for the ignore rules (FR-13): review = a transaction message that also carries an ignore word and no OTP code (a security footer): on device a Smart Inbox review row, never dropped silently; on the server rejected with no AI. ignored = a genuine OTP or promotion: dropped silently on device; rejected with no AI on the server. src V1-RES4 = the review of the last parser commit (L, LR-01..LR-08) and the earlier review K: every probe of both (K's 94, L's 101) plus counter-cases, each with its correct outcome. More not-completed wordings ('did not go through', 'has not been completed/approved/processed', 'refused', 'could not process', 'cannot be completed', 'bounced', 'awaiting confirmation', 'under review', 'being processed', bare 'لم تتم', 'تم إلغاء', 'قيد التنفيذ'); 'merchant' introduces a name only with a colon ('Merchant: X', not 'Merchant declined …'); a cue that ends its sentence after an introducer is a status ('from pending to declined'); a generic noun followed by an amount is a status header ('Failed payments SAR 100'). LR-04/LR-05: 'ignored' also covers adverts and account notices (credit limit, card activation, statements, PIN, beneficiary: nonTransactionKeywords); an ignore word inside the merchant name ('Offer Mart') does not apply (completed_payment); a footer, link or complaint line on a complete transaction is 'review'. Three more completed outcomes: completed_income (device income; server credit income), completed_withdrawal (device withdrawal; server debit payment), completed_transfer_in (device transfer; server credit income). A case with "server": "unresolved" is a known disagreement in the safe direction: the device (with the sender's bank profile) records it, the server leaves it unresolved (no total change). Cases tagged V1-RES4 whose text reports a completed movement but whose expect is not_completed or review are known false positives kept in review (no total change). This is not complete coverage of bank wording. src V1-RES5 = review N (NR-01..NR-06): every probe of that review (122 completed messages 'N-new', the 66 golden layouts with an available-limit line 'N-gold' whose truth is the movement 0095a239 recorded, the not-completed wordings and their counter-cases 'N-cue'). expect is now always the TRUE outcome of the text; where a side knowingly deviates without changing totals the row says so: device = the on-device outcome when it differs (review / not_completed = a Smart Inbox review row; dropped = no amount read, never silently ignored, a Smart Inbox card for a bank sender; transfer = recorded as a direction-neutral transfer), server = the server outcome when it differs (unresolved; not_completed = rejected by a cue; review = rejected with no AI). An account notice word (credit limit, activation, statement, PIN: nonTransactionKeywords) never changes the outcome of a message that names a money movement (moneyKeywords); a notice that names an amount and no movement is review on the device, rejected on the server. src V1-RES9 = round 9: every probe of review P (amount, credit, notice-footer, balance and code sets) with its true amount, currency (when the text names one) and direction; four probes whose true amount is itself ambiguous (tip/VAT totals) are left out. A completed row may deviate on device only to review/not_completed, a transfer, 'dropped' (no amount read: with a bank sender a Smart Inbox card, never silent) or another recorded type in the SAME direction (an incoming transfer recorded as income); never ignored, never the opposite direction, never another amount. The open OR-03b/OR-07 defect pins are gone (fixed). src V1-RES10 = round 10: every probe of review Q (its 250 messages, ids Q000-Q249) with the review's own hand truth (d = completed_payment, or completed_withdrawal for a cash withdrawal; c = completed_income, or completed_credit for a returned debit; t = completed_transfer_own, money moved between the user's own accounts, which no total should count; n = not_completed, or ignored for a promotion; Q's one ambiguous reversal is not_completed by the reversed-original policy). Outcomes the code still gets wrong (each as at ab5dc10a or better) are pinned with defect = 'OPEN ...' naming the wrong outcome; only these rows carry a defect. Round 10 also moved existing pins where behaviour legitimately changed (round-9 credit words and the OR-01 money words removed, the notice scope restored, 'POS' read as a word): each move is a recorded outcome becoming device review, server unresolved, or an AI answer the validator does not confirm (ai).
